does: Bakes an empty pastry case, so that a wet filling does not leave the base raw and soggy.

intro.what: An empty pastry case is baked before its wet filling is added.
intro.why: Giving the pastry a dry structure first helps explain why a filling can otherwise leave the base soggy.

how: Line the tin with the pastry and chill it until firm.
Prick the base with a fork, cover it with paper and fill it with baking beans.
Bake until the edges are set, then lift out the paper and the beans.
Bake a little longer, until the base looks dry and pale gold.

cues.text: A dry, matt base with no grey, greasy patches, and edges of pale gold.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping the chill, so that the pastry shrinks down the sides of the tin.
mistakes.fix: Rest the lined tin in the fridge until the pastry is firm.

mistakes.mistake: Taking the beans out too soon, so that the base puffs up.
mistakes.fix: Wait until the edges hold their shape.

quiz.question: Why bake the empty case before adding a wet filling?
choices: To establish a dry pastry base.
To keep the base soft and damp.
To keep the pastry flexible enough to soak up the filling.
quiz.because: Prebaking gives the pastry structure before moisture from the filling reaches it.

quiz.question: When should the paper and baking beans be lifted out?
choices: As soon as the tin enters the oven.
After the pastry edges have set.
Before the chilled pastry has begun baking.
quiz.because: The weights support the pastry until it can hold its shape.

quiz.question: Which base is the intended result?
choices: Grey and greasy with wet patches.
Puffed into a large central mound.
Dry and matt with pale golden edges.
quiz.because: A dry matt surface is the cue that the empty base has baked beyond its damp stage.

quiz.question: The pastry shrank down the tin. What should change next time?
choices: Chill the lined case until firm before baking.
Skip chilling to keep the pastry soft.
Remove the weights before the edges set.
quiz.because: Resting the lined tin in the fridge helps the pastry retain its shape during baking.

variant_of.differs: A pastry case is baked empty and weighed down, before any filling goes in.
